title: Dose–response per substance per sex, simulated (seed 11)

banc.analysis:
No drug: share of all neurons firing per step averaged 0.016 over 3 runs (from 0.016 to 0.016).
Full dose: share of all neurons firing per step averaged 0.042 over 3 runs (from 0.042 to 0.042) — 161% more than no drug. 3 of 3 runs were on the predicted side of the no drug average; the gap (0.026) is 433.6× the run-to-run wobble (0.000).
Verdict for full dose: SUPPORTED — the direction held in almost every run and the gap is bigger than the wobble.
